Vendored so the app needs no CDN (only the map style/tile host is fetched at runtime):
- leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause): dist/leaflet.js, dist/leaflet.css, dist/images
- maplibre-gl 5.24.0 (BSD-3-Clause): dist/maplibre-gl.js, dist/maplibre-gl.css
- @maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet 0.1.4 (ISC): leaflet-maplibre-gl.js
- leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3 (MIT): dist/leaflet.markercluster.js, MarkerCluster.css, MarkerCluster.Default.css
